s: Din tzv"tz berosh hashshana ubo seip echad: ap al pi sheshshear yom tob shechal beshabbat en omerim "tzidqateka" bemincha, abal berosh hashshana shechal beshabbat omerim, lepi shehu yom din verauy lomar tzidduq haddin beyom din, vekak nohagin bisparad. Abal yesh omerim sheap berosh hashshana shechal beshabbat en omerim oto, mippene shekkatub bo "mishpateka tehom rabba", veen leorer haddin beyom din, veod shehayyom rosh chodesh veen omerim "tzidqateka" berosh chodesh kemo shennitbaer besiman rtz"b.
